body:
It looks good visually @LukyVj but it does not work:

 - all the pages are broken (all have the same landing page look, [widget](https://deploy-preview-2206--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/widgets.html), [connectors](https://deploy-preview-2206--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/connectors.html), [usage](https://deploy-preview-2206--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/guides/usage.html)...) They all look like the landing page.
 - all the links in the page are dead (discover widget, learn more, get started, signup)
 - there is an issue with the community logo in the header (we see only the colored square)
 - the menu was changed and is not following the expected hierarchy (getting started, guides, API, examples)
